title: Share Screen with Chief: the Chief chat header's sharing toggle, off and on, in dark and light (user 2026-10-30: "share screen with chief and have it incorporated into memories")

steps.title: Go to Home
steps.optional: Home needs its page in this build

steps.title: Dark: the Chief chat header with Share Screen with Chief off (top right)

steps.title: Light: stopped, the toggle is off again
